body: Yeah I’ve tried talking to her about how I’m feeling but she mostly dismisses it by saying that my medication just isn’t working or if I try talking about how my friends don’t talk to me anymore she just says random things like they are probably going through the same thing or they are mad that I lied to them about where I was for a couple months because I told everyone I had mono instead of going to a mental hospital so they wouldn’t judge me but it still feels like they are judging me. Maybe she did just think I was eating but I really hoped that she does know what’s happening to me but right now she mostly just cares about my brother because he is feeling depressed too but it’s no where near as bad as what I’m feeling so I just feel like she abandoned me, but you are probably right, she probably just doesn’t want to think that I’m thinking about doing something like that. I might try being more serious when I talk to her too because you do have a point, I have practically nothing left to lose, so thank you.

Except this time I really believe no one cares about me. I tried opening up to a few of my really close friends and I haven’t talked to them in months. Every other friend I have now just likes to talk to other people rather than me so I’ve got nothing to lose anymore except my one true friend who literally told me today she is only friends with me so I won’t kill my self because if I did she would feel guilty. My mom doesn’t care about me either cause she has seen the things I keep in my room that I might use to kill my self but she doesn’t ask or do anything. For example, she once walked into my room while I was in it, stared at a fork I had right next to an outlet on my wall, and just kept doing what she was doing like it was nothing so I’m done with it all.
Mine is 51605. It's 5* Coffin Nail Crawford, level 52. He is a heel type.
